notes: Checked via direct HTTP: robots.txt (Anthropic-AI explicitly Allow: /, no Claude-specific disallow), the full uk-sitemap.xml index, sitemap_Category.xml (365 URLs), sitemap_CategoryLanding.xml (22 URLs) and sitemap_Content.xml (107 URLs, editorial only). Header/mega-menu and PLP content are client-rendered, so pages were rendered with a local headless Chromium (Playwright) to read the real DOM, breadcrumbs and item counts. The site's main Christmas hub (/uk/c/christmas) currently displays 'Our Christmas Shop is coming soon' (checked 2026-09-03) with no product grid - the Christmas taxonomy exists structurally (breadcrumb paths under /uk/Christmas/...) but only some leaf pages are already stocked; two leaf pages under 'The Little White Company Christmas Shop' (Children's Christmas Stockings, Children's Christmas Pyjamas) returned 0 items and were dropped per the 0-product-category rule, and a third sitemap URL for children's stocking fillers 301-redirects to the coming-soon hub (stale, dropped). No Halloween, Diwali, Thanksgiving, or New Year categories exist anywhere on the UK site (confirmed absent across both category sitemaps and the rendered mega-menu). Excluded as non-genuine-category: /uk/Offers/c/christmas-offers and /uk/Sale/c/christmas-sale (Offers/Sale branches per shared exclusion rule); /uk/Christmas/c/gifts-delivered-for-christmas (78 items, but it is a cross-category delivery-cutoff filter - 'gifts guaranteed for Christmas' spanning candles, hampers, blankets, toys, frames - not a genuine product-type category, same family as Best Sellers/New Arrivals curation); /uk/Candles-and-Fragrance/c/beauty-advent-calendar (single-product 'join the waitlist' signup page for the unreleased 2026 advent calendar, no product grid); /uk/Clothing/c/holiday-shop and /uk/Baby-and-Children/c/little-white-holiday-shop (British-English 'holiday' = vacation here - both are Beachwear/Swimwear pages, not festive); /uk/Clothing/c/seasonal-collection and /uk/Home/c/seasonal-home-dining-edit (editorial campaign pages titled 'The Drama in Simplicity' and 'The Rustic Table', not holiday-specific). Included: the live Christmas leaf PLPs (Christmas Table > Serveware/Barware; Christmas Gifts > Stocking Fillers/Fragrance Gift Sets/Baby's First Christmas), plus standalone Easter, Valentine's Day, Mother's Day and Father's Day gift PLPs found in the sitemap (each confirmed live via rendered item counts).
